item.title: Passport Control for Robots: SAIL vs OKTA
item.description: AI agents pay the identity registry, not the login. Governance is priced per identity, login per employee. Within listed identity, SailPoint owns the better-placed layer at the lower multiple.

item.title: The Mall Is Closing: Shopify, Meta's Muse and the Agentic Storefront
item.description: When AI agents do the shopping, the rails get paid every time (Shopify), the assistant that knows the buyer earns a commission (Meta), and the everything store has to reinvent itself or shrink (Amazon).
